checkpoint_notes: AMP final model_99999.pt is the final checkpoint after 100000 training iterations.
limitations: Nominal flat simulation, deterministic policy, no pushes/domain randomization/resets; not terrain recovery evaluation.
Recovery requires root height >0.65m and gz<-0.9 for 1s within 20s. Reported recovery time includes that 1s hold.
Motion-quality values average per-pose RMS in fixed first3s/last5s windows. 50Hz joint acceleration is not a complete measure of naturalness.
K47 vs L47 is one-seed same-progress ablation; cannot infer statistical significance across training seeds.
K/L train on terrain, AMP controls on flat; cross-family comparisons are task performance comparisons, not pure algorithm ablations.

Normalized action deltas depend on model output scale; compare physical joint measures first.

findings: Matched47k: reducing height reward halves coefficient but reduces first3s joint acceleration RMS by only ~1.1%; recovery100% in both. Last5s joint acceleration RMS increases from0.597 to1.148rad/s².
Balanced dual AMP100k recovery932/1268; local repeat941/1268. Historical50k1262/1268. This checkpoint shows recovery regression despite high training episode length.
Shared AMP100k both seeds1267/1268; unbalanced dual1266/1268. No demonstrated overall balanced-dual advantage in these checkpoints.
Original-height SuperMimic89k recovery1268/1268, but forward3 command final5s upright93.5% and post-recovery joint acceleration RMS4.998rad/s². Latest checkpoint is not uniformly best.
